# TinySoundFont

`tsf.h` is vendored from the upstream TinySoundFont project:

https://github.com/schellingb/TinySoundFont

It is distributed under the MIT license shown at the top of the header.  This
tree enables the local `TSF_USE_INT16_SAMPLES` option so a compact SoundFont
can fit in the ESP32-P4's PSRAM.
